item.text: {"iteration":5,"pcvs":[{"name":"projection_elements","expression":"hidden_states.shape[0] * attn.inner_dim * (hidden_states.shape[1] + (hidden_states.shape[1] if encoder_hidden_states is None else encoder_hidden_states.shape[1]))","rationale":"Captures projection and normalization costs across query and context tokens."},{"name":"rotary_elements","expression":"hidden_states.shape[0] * hidden_states.shape[1] * attn.inner_dim if rotary_emb is not None else 0","rationale":"Restores an independent linear cost for rotary operations, which the previous candidate omitted."},{"name":"attention_tail_elements","expression":"hidden_states.shape[0] * attn.heads * hidden_states.shape[1] * ((hidden_states.shape[1] if encoder_hidden_states is None else encoder_hidden_states.shape[1]) % 16)","rationale":"Captures scalar attention remainder work across all query rows, including short cross-attention contexts."},{"name":"uses_rotary","expression":"int(rotary_emb is not None)","rationale":"Separates fixed rotary dispatch and allocation overhead from its elementwise cost."}],"hypothesis":"Combining independent rotary elementwise work with attention remainder work may explain the residuals better than either previous model alone. For these short sequences, full vector-block attention work may be less important than these two costs."}
